items.name: Ember Cragglepod
items.description: A cragglepod commonly found in the depths of Sunken Sunvault. While often skittish in the wild, they warm up quickly to those it trusts.

items.name: Viridian Cragglepod
items.description: This vibrant cragglepod is known for its bold personality and impenetrable shell. It can be social - even garrulous - with those it considers friends.

items.name: Roseflame Cragglepod
items.description: This cragglepod's rosy hue and sweet disposition comes from its diet of sugary sun sap! The light on its head burns more gently than others.

items.name: Sunkissed Froleek
items.description: Froleek enjoy cavorting throughout the Chiseled Caverns, from dancing in Moonglow Grotto to sunbathing in Sunken Sunvault.

items.name: Jubilant Froleek
items.description: Vibrant leaves set this dazzling Froleek apart from others. It never tires of expressing its joy, whether its getting treats, pets, or even a little bit of attention.

items.name: Wistful Froleek
items.description: Unlike its brethren, this pensive Froleek enjoys solitude and quiet. It can often be found daydreaming alone in  peaceful pools of cave milk.

items.name: Curious Gleemur
items.description: Blink and you might miss the Gleemur, who easily blend into their verdant environments. A coolheaded creature, always up for a challenge.

items.name: Shrouded Gleemur
items.description: Sightings of this Gleemur only began after the Shadow's infiltration. It survived by disguising itself to fit its sundered environs.

items.name: Impish Gleemur
items.description: Study of this playful Gleemur has proven difficult due to its frequent theft of Sunseeker notes. Unapologetic pranksters, the lot of them.

items.name: Growing Heckbug
items.description: Babies are always cute, but this one might be an exception.

items.name: Cragged Heckbug
items.description: Four legs means four times the speed, right?

items.name: Heckbug-Hybrid Hopper
items.description: There's a lot of evidence that this thing can hop great distances, but no one has ever seen it actually hop.

items.name: Hoppin' Heckbug
items.description: The heckbugs that can't fly still find a way.

items.name: Angler Heckbug-Hybrid
items.description: It's hard to tell why it lights the way since it has no eyes.

items.name: Four Faced Heckbug-Hybrid
items.description: It's hard to tell if this is one heckbug or many banded together. Either way it's disturbing.

items.name: Abhorrent Heckbug
items.description: If this is what Geode does to heckbugs, let's just hope they never make it to the surface.

items.name: Zippin' Heckbug
items.description: Wings? They fly? This keeps getting worse!

items.name: Dragonfly Heckbug
items.description: Dragonflys are mystical, but this one still scares me.

items.name: Bouncy Hoppet
items.description: With its highly social personality, Hoppet were the first cave creatures domesticated by Geodians. It loves being around others, especially when sweets are on offer.

items.name: Effervescent Hoppet
items.description: Bright-eyed and bouncy, this Hoppet is irrepressible even in the face of Shadows. It is oblivious to danger, too innocent to fathom being harmed.

items.name: Handsome Hoppet
items.description: Because of this Hoppet's love of cave milk baths, its skin is flawless - and it knows it! - always happy to gaze at its own reflection or bat its silken eyelashes at passersby.

items.name: Fresh Howlug
items.description: Green as the Verdant Veins, this Howlug gets its hue from eating ten times its weight in cave kelp daily! An insatiable appetite for an incorrigible scamp.

items.name: Supersonic Howlug
items.description: This Howlug, with its singular racing stripe, loves to slime circles around its kind. Though it's not actually any faster, it is no doubt a legend in its own mind.

items.name: Glamorous Howlug
items.description: With its robust coloring and spellbinding eyes, this Howlug is a beauty, only sparing a glance for the most vivacious of courtship dances.

items.name: Amber Jelotl
items.description: This common jelotl is happy to meander anywhere, watering its environments as it jaunts from flower to flower, plant to plant.

items.name: Spectral Jelotl
items.description: When the Shadows came, many jelotl habitats were destroyed. This jelotl survived by masking itself in chaotic energy - a bright spot in a dark time.

items.name: Waverider Jelotl
items.description: Always drenched, this uncommon jelotl makes a splash wherever it goes! It is an affectionate pet when tamed, so do your shoes a favor and go barefoot.

items.name: Quizzical Qubrik
items.description: Ancient cave paintings suggest that these mysterious and mercurial creatures have been observing boulder and pebble life from afar for centuries.

items.name: Enigmatic Qubrik
items.description: When looking upon this Qubrik, one thinks of the Geodian poet, Breccia Schist, who wrote, 'In this strange mirror, we see all of the world.'

items.name: Delicate Qubrik
items.description: These emotional Qubrik hold onto embarrassment so tightly, their bodies turn pink forever - or at least longer than most Geodian life spans!

items.name: Zigzag Zepperay
items.description: Given the Zepperay's shyness, watching this creature run away may be all that strangers experience of it - yet how fortunate we are that its speed itself is a wonder!

items.name: Majestic Zepperay
items.description: How lightly its wings flutter! It is a pleasure to watch this Zepperay drift through Moonglow Grotto, as lilting and winsome as Geodian song.

items.name: Lithe Zepperay
items.description: Pink from its waggling tongue to its twitching tail, this Zepperay streaks across the skies as naturally as blush across a waking dawn.

items.description:

items.name: Acrobat Bark
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nHangs down from the ceilings in Tiers 2-4 of Moonglow Grotto.

items.name: Ancient Gears
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nScavenged from the deepest corners of Tier 5 of the Geode caves.

items.name: Ember Trails
items.description: Drops in all Adventure World biomes, excluding Dragonfire Peaks and Peaceful Hills but only if the 'The Cindrakken the Emberscale Dragon' event is currently ACTIVE (check the /welcome screen! [HK:WelcomeScreen])

items.name: Auric Array
items.description: A glowing component of Ancient physiology, used to emit energy and manipulate matter from a distance.

items.name: Bamboo Shoot
items.description: Obtained from the Forbidden Spires, but if and only if the 'Duraveln - the Bamboo Dragon' event is currently ACTIVE (check the /welcome screen! [HK:WelcomeScreen])
items.guide: BAMBOO SHOOTS are harvested in the FORBIDDEN SPIRES biome when the Event is active.

items.name: Bardium
items.description: Crafting Material. A pulsing gold and blue ore that when touched fills ones head with musical inspiration.\n\nThis ore is found rarely in Tier 5 of the Geode caves.

items.name: Arena Coin
items.description: Spend with the Battle Broker to unlock arena rewards. The Battle Broker can be found in the Battle Station in the Trove Hub.\n\nEarned by Loot Collecting Banners from Battle Mode Boxes.

items.name: Binding Darkness
items.description: Crafting Material. Tendrils of deepest shadow, forged into inextricable fetters. Used at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench to craft Gems Augments.\n\nObtained in Gem Booster Boxes and rarely from World Bosses.

items.name: PembloCoin
items.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by lovers of canines.\n\nFound very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

items.name: SkygoldCoin
items.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by sky-high rollers.\n\nFound very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

items.name: MoonCoin
items.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by night owls and loons.\n\nFound very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

items.name: NotTroveCoin
items.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by anarchists and those who rage against the established order.\n\nFound very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

items.name: CurrentCoin
items.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by those who like to clean-sweep the exchanges.\n\nFound very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

items.name: IllogiCoin
items.description: A form of cryptocurrency for those who embrace chaos and disdain soundly-formed projections.\n\nFound very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

items.name: Blank Scroll
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nObtained by Loot Collecting scrolls from Recipe Dungeons.

items.name: Blazine
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nHeat emanates from this ore found only in Tiers 1-3 of Sunken Sunvault.

items.name: Bond Crystalizer
items.description: A manifestation of the experiences you and your companion have shared. Used to level up companions.\n\nCraftable on the Crystallogy Workbench.

items.name: Bleached Bone
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nThese bones are commonly found littering the ground in Dragonfire Peaks.
items.guide: BLEACHED BONES can be harvested from the DRAGONFIRE PEAKS biome.

items.name: Bottle
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nBottles are found growing wildly throughout the world or can be grown through Gardening.
items.guide: BOTTLES can be harvested throughout Trove Adventure Worlds.

items.name: Bound Brilliance
items.description: Crafting Material. A physical receptacle for captured light. Used at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench to craft Gems Augments.\n\nObtained from the Weekly Class Power Rank Leaderboards and from Events.

items.name: Sticky Ichor
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nFound by defeating bugs.
items.guide: STICKY ICHOR can be found on bug enemies across Trove.

items.name: Builderite
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nOne of the Builder's favorite ores, found deep throughout Tiers 3-5 of the Geode caves.

items.name: Builder's Blossom
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nBlooms deep within Tiers 4-5 of Verdant Veins.

items.name: Moonlight Bulb
items.description:
Crafting Material. Focused lunar energy that can be used to craft Alchemy Plant seeds at the Gardening Bench.

BEWARE: Q'bthulhu is watchful of Trovians using the Moon Goddess's power and will find and REMOVE ALL MOONLIGHT BULBS from their bags when they go offline.

Moonlight Bulbs can be found all over Trove and the Geode Topside.

items.name: Sunlight Bulb
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nFound in the Giant Sunflowers that pepper the Peaceful Hills.
items.guide: SUNLIGHT BULBS are most commonly harvested from the PEACEFUL HILLS biome.

items.name: Soul of the Depths
items.description:
This vessel vibrates with magical Runic energy. Used by Runecrafters to unlock their maximum power. 

Found within RUNIC DEPTHS VAULTS, within THE DEPTHS Delve biome.

items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nCreated at the Ringcrafting Bench.

items.description: Crafting material.\n\nCreated at the Ringcrafting bench.

items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nCreated at the Ringcrafting Bench.

items.name: Despoiled Divinity
items.description: Rare Crafting Material.\n\nFrequently discovered in Delves within Shadowy Soul Vaults alongside Titan and Lunar Souls. Up to five can be found per week.
items.guide:
Up to five (5) DESPOILED DIVINITY per week can be obtained from SHADOWY SOUL VAULTS, found periodically in Delves. A DELVE SHADOWKEY must be used to open Shadowy Soul Vaults. These can be crafted at an All Purpose Key Mold, which are found nearby the Shadowy Soul Vault.

Can also be obtained rarely through other methods.

items.name: Dragon Coin
items.description: Used to hatch Dragons at the Dragon Crucible in the Hub.\n\nAcquire by doing challenges or from the Dragon tab in the store (Press [HK:Store] Key).
items.guide:
DRAGON COINS are found within DRAGON CACHES.

Lesser Dragon Caches are awarded for participating in the periodic, time-limited Challenges (including Rampages, Hub-portal minigames, and Dungeon Challenges).

Greater Dragon Caches can always be purchased from the Store [HK:Store] using Credits or Cubits.

items.name: Diamond Dragonite
items.description: Crafting Material. A primordial shard used to craft items of immense power, including Primordial Dragons at the Dragon Crucible in the Hub.\n\nObtained daily from filling the Star Bar and from opening Diamond Dragonite Pouches.

items.name: Dragon Fang
items.description: Crystallized by time into an obsidian-like mineral.

Their magic will fade shortly after the end of Lunar Plunge.

Belief in Elsphodel and the purity of Q'rsbane forged into a potent cure.

One bird's trash is another bird's treasure!

Crafted by the amazingly adaptive and efficient Bin Chickens, currently found scattered throughout the FAE FOREST biome.

They may need a little encouragement before they're willing to craft for you, though...

items.description:
Crafting Material.

Depending on the magnification factor of your eyes, these lil' friendlies can be surprisingly cute!

items.description:
Crafting Material.

items.guide: ASHEN SOULS come from the Ashen enemies in the lower, "Ashen Wastes" of the SUNDERED UPLANDS biome.

Crafting Material.

items.name: Sundercharge Crystal

Crafting Material.

items.description:
Geode-Age material, designed to allow storage of massive amounts of Nitro-Glitterine (certainly more than is safe), without risking ANY loss* due to radioactive decay!

Use the Sunseeker's Crystalforge to extract the full Nitro amount!

* without risking any Nitro loss... loss of life is neither guaranteed nor implied!

items.name: Commemorative Pinzon
items.description:
Previously worthless, their worthlessness has once again made them worth something. Now a commemorative coin as a lasting relic from one of the most successful Pinzo scams to date.

Destroy (loot collect) this item for the good of Trove.

items.name: Share of Pinzo's Products
items.description:
This cerifificate confers ownership of one share of the Pinzo's Products LLC.

Warning: The owner of this product certifies their knowledge that it's value is highly volatile and upon reaching zero, becomes null and void.

Destroy (loot collect) this for the good of Trove.

items.name: Pinzo's Perfect Products
items.description:
Pinzo's Perfectly Crafted Products consistently provide precisely perfected outcomes.

Pinzo's up to something again. Use this item to start an activity to handle this inevitable Pinzo Problem.

items.name: Pinzo's Right Boot
items.description:
While not sure why everyone is seeking it, Chuck Pinzo is not one to look a gift horse in the mouth. This right boot comes with all the bells and whistles one can expect from a right boot.

Warning: This boot is for viewing only and has no practical purpose.

Destroy (loot collect) this for the good of Trove.

items.name: Super Mega Pinz-Tank
items.description:
The best flux tank flux can buy. Converts Megaflux Tanks into the Super Mega Pinz-Tank, which is better in every conceivable way.

Destroy (loot collect) this for the good of Trove.

items.name: Giant Pumpkin Pie
items.description: Gifted to Qubesly during the Shadow's Eve 2017 event. Due to the magic of the season, can be Loot Collected back into raw pumpkins if extras are baked!

items.name: Diggsly's Token
items.description: A token of Diggsly's gratitude. Can be traded to Mortsdot during Subterranean Scramble or crafted into Leaderboard Reward Chests at the Wheel of Seasons after the event has ended.\n\nAcquired during the Subterranean Scramble 2019 event, these coins may vanish over time.

items.name: Shadowy Seal 2018
items.description: Can be used at the Shadowy Station in Crafter's Corner of the Trove Hub to craft a unique lootbox and collections.\n\nA token granted during Shadow's Eve 2018 event, these coins will disappear at the end of Shadow's Eve 2019.

items.name: Shadowy Seal 2019
items.description: Can be used at the Shadowy Station in Crafter's Corner of the Trove Hub to craft a unique lootbox and collections.\n\nA token granted during Shadow's Eve 2019 event, these coins will disappear shortly after the end of Shadow's Eve 2019.

items.name: Snowy Seal 2019
items.description: Smells like peppermint. Snowy Seals can be used at the Snowfest Table in Crafter's Corner of the Trove Hub to craft a unique lootbox and collections\n\nEarned by completing Snowfest 2019 Event Adventures, these festive coins will disappear shortly after the end of Snowfest 2019.

items.name: Shadowy Catalyst
items.description:
Qubesly seems to trust the book that produced this curious, awful-smelling liquid...
Disappears after Snowfest 2020

items.name: Snowfest Seal
items.description:
Obtained by doing Daily Snowfest Adventures offered in the Hub. Used to craft Snowfest themed mounts, allies, and more at the Snowfest Table in the Hub!
Disappears after Snowfest 2020

items.name: Subzero Snowflake
items.description:
Found inside Present and Tree Dungeons in Adventure Worlds. Used to craft at the Snowfest Table.
Disappears after Snowfest 2020

items.name: Subzero Shadowflake
items.description:
Only from Delve Depths above 0, oddly enough. Though its uses are just being probed by the Delver's Guild, Diggsly is confident of this material's value, and has send the Guild and Trovians alike down into the Delves to begin immediate extraction!
Disappears after Snowfest 2020

items.name: Glashadial Shard
items.description: Crafted at the Snowfest Table. Neither Qubesly nor the Delver's Guild has a complete understanding of how this stuff works.

items.name: Stick
items.description: Brown and sticky.\n\nEarned by defeating Shadow-y Pinatas while representing a Sunfest House that has been tasked with rebuilding the fire. All Sticks are used whenever the fire is rebuilt.

items.name: Turkofu
items.description: I can't believe it isn't meat!\n\nUncooked Turkofu will vanish at the end of Turkeytopia

items.name: Qubesly's Family Secrets
items.description: These juicy secrets are used when learning to cook Turkofu Cornucopias.\n\nEarned by helping Qubesly during Turkeytopia 2019, these secrets will expire once the event is over.

items.name: Quirkstone
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nConfetti-covered ore found deep in Tiers 3-5 of Moonglow Grotto.

items.name: Radiant Shard
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nEarned by completing the Dark Heart dungeons found in the Sky Realms.
items.guide: RADIANT SHARDS can be obtained by completing the Dark Heart Dungeons found in CURSED SKYLANDS Worlds.

items.name: Coded Message
items.description: A coded message left behind by Resistors. A Decoder Ring may reveal its secrets...\n\nCrafted at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis.

items.name: Intriguing Kernel Map
items.description: Among those who seek out the Resistor's message, rumors abound of a trail of kernels that may lead to 'a powerful force against the Amperium.'\n\nCrafted at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis.

items.name: Decoder Ring
items.description: Warmth emanates from it, as if it held some latent power. The distinct pattern engraved on it has been seen scattered across Luminopolis.\n\nCrafted at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis.

items.name: Robotic Salvage
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nFound by defeating robotic enemies in Neon City and Neon City, Luminopolis.
items.guide: ROBOTIC SALVAGE is found on robotic enemies in Neon City and Luminopolis.

items.name: Zephyr Essence
items.description:
Obtained by converting various LONG SHADE difficulty harvests at Saltwater Sam's Depths Workbench.
Long Shade difficulty can be accessed via the Atlas [HK:Atlas].
items.guide: ZEPHYR ESSENCES can be found across DEPTHS related content, found in LONG SHADE Difficulty (15) worlds.

items.name: Pyric Essence
items.description:
Obtained by converting various LONG SHADE difficulty harvests at Saltwater Sam's Depths Workbench.
Long Shade difficulty can be accessed via the Atlas [HK:Atlas].
items.guide: PYRIC ESSENCES can be found across DEPTHS related content, found in LONG SHADE Difficulty (15) worlds.

items.name: Runic Essence
items.description:
Obtained by converting various LONG SHADE difficulty harvests at Saltwater Sam's Depths Workbench.
Long Shade difficulty can be accessed via the Atlas [HK:Atlas].

items.name: Abyssal Essence
items.description:
Obtained by converting various LONG SHADE difficulty harvests at Saltwater Sam's Depths Workbench.
Long Shade difficulty can be accessed via the Atlas [HK:Atlas].
items.guide: ABYSSAL ESSENCES can be found across DEPTHS related content, found in LONG SHADE Difficulty (15) worlds.

items.name: Abundance Rune
items.description:
Breaks upon completing a dungeon, spawning a bonus chest.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Harvest Rune
items.description:
Breaks upon completing a dungeon, granting a buff that gives a chance to obtain Encrusted Runic Trunk when harvesting resources unique to Long Shade difficulty (15).

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Repel Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, triggering an explosion that knock backs enemies and roots them.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Swift Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you dash, increasing attack speed by 30% and movement speed by 10 for 60 seconds.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Zephyr Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you take damage from acid, making you immune for 10 seconds.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Condemn Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, triggering a rage that increases your damage by 20%.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Focus Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you spend all of your energy, replenishing your energy to full.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Fury Rune
items.description:
Breaks sometimes when you deal damage. In addition hitting can trigger one of three Fury Rune buffs, increasing Critical Hit Chance, Critical Hit Damage, and overall Damage.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Pyric Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you use your ultimate ability, creating a large fire around you burning your enemies for 10 seconds.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Recursion Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you land a critical attack, granting 35% Critical Damage for 60 seconds.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Rune Slate
items.description:
Layering magic and matter, Rune Slate provides a metaphorical lattice upon which all Runic magic can grow and thrive.
Used by the Runecrafting profession.

items.name: Rune Fragment
items.description: Used by Runecrafters to craft basic Runes, as well as materials for more advanced Runes.

items.name: Rune Paper
items.description:
Imbuing Blank Scrolls with primal energies, Runecrafters can craft this thin, flexible material. It is resistant arcane stress and smells like chemicals... in a good way.
Used by the Runecrafting profession.

items.name: Blank Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting a few Rune Fragments.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Empty Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting some Rune Fragments.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Depths Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting many Rune Fragments.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Ore Rune
items.description:
Breaks as a result of mining resources, granting a bonus chance at a Miner's Trove when mining resources.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Shining Rune
items.description: Breaks when your magic find triggers, granting a Gearcrafter's Vault.

items.name: Metallic Rune
items.description:
Breaks on damage taken, granting a protecting shield that reduces damage by 20% for 10 seconds and increases Stability.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Rippling Rune
items.description: Breaks when catching a fish from a pool, granting a buff that can award Marks of the Angler when completing dungeons.

items.name: Abyssal Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you would take damage from lava or Jellous's flames but grants immunity to the damage from lava and Jellous's flames.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Endurance Rune
items.description:
Breaks sometimes when you take damage. Taking Damage can also trigger an Endurance effect, reducing damage taken, increasing Maximum Health, and granting Stability.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Rally Rune
items.description:
Breaks when an enemy is defeated, healing you for 50% of your health.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Replenishment Rune
items.description:
Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, reducing your cooldowns by 33%.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Restoration Rune
items.description:
Breaks after defeating an enemy, restoring a charge of your equipped flask.

Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

items.name: Runic Key Fragment
items.description: Found by defeating dungeons in the highest difficulty worlds.

items.name: Ancient Scale
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nObtained by Loot Collecting rare fish.
items.guide: ANCIENT SCALES are found when LOOT COLLECTING rare Fish.

items.name: Scale of the Depths
items.description:
Crafting Material.

Obtained by Loot Collecting rare fish from the Depths.
items.guide: SCALE OF THE DEPTHS is obtained by LOOT COLLETING specific Rare Depths Fish.

items.name: Enchanted Scale
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nObtained by Loot Collecting Enchanted fish.
items.guide: ENCHANTED SCALES are found when LOOT COLLETING rare, Enchanted Fish.

items.name: Golden Seashell
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nFound most often in the Treasure Isles.
items.guide: GOLDEN SEASHELLS can be found in the LOST ISLES biome.

items.name: Sentience Shard
items.description: Rare Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis.\n\nObtained from completing Rampage Challenges, Beacons, Legendary Tomes and Greater Neon Caches.
items.guide: SENTIENCE SHARDS are obtained from completing RAMPAGE CHALLENGES, but can also be found in GREATER NEON CACHES and other locations.

items.name: Shadow Key Fragments
items.description: Legacy Crafting Material. Can be exchanged for Delve Shadowkey Fragments at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench. Extra Shadow Key Fragments will eventually fade back into Shadow.

items.name: Shadow Key Gem
items.description: Crafting Material. An old item, place in a Loot Collector for something useful. Extra Shadow Key Gems will eventually fade back into Shadow.

items.name: Moon Key Fragments
items.description: Legacy Crafting Material. Can be exchanged for Delve Shadowkey Fragments at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench. Extra Moon Key Fragments will eventually fade back into Shadow.

items.name: Moon Key Gem
items.description: Crafting Material. An old item, place in a Loot Collector for something useful. Extra Moon Key Gems will eventually fade back into Shadow.

items.name: Eclipse Key Fragments
items.description: Legacy Crafting Material. Can be exchanged for Delve Shadowkey Fragments at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench. Extra Eclipse Key Fragments will eventually fade back into Shadow.

items.name: Candy Corn
items.description:
Crafting Material. Used to craft items at the Shadowy Station in Crafter's Corner of the Trove Hub.

Found by defeating Pumpkin dungeons in any biome or world.

Candy Corn will vanish shortly after Shadow's Eve 2019.

items.name: Candy Corn
items.description:
Crafting Material. Used to craft items at the Shadowy Station in Crafter's Corner of the Trove Hub.

Found by defeating Pumpkin dungeons in any biome or world.

items.name: Lunar Condensate
items.description:
Currency & Crafting Material. Accepted by Order of the Moon Quartermasters and is used to craft items at the Shadowy Station in Crafter''s Corner of the Trove Hub.

Found by defeating enemies in the Cursed Vale and Wolves' Den during Shadow's Eve.

items.name: Shadow Shard
items.description: Crafting Material. Used to craft mounts and items on the Shadowy Market such as Shadow Caches.\n\nA plentiful crafting material found in Delves.
items.guide: SHADOW SHARDS are found in Delves of sufficient Depth.

items.name: Heart of Darkness
items.description: Rare Crafting Material.\n\nFound in Shadow Caches, which can be bought for Shadow Shards in the Shadowy Market.
items.guide: HEARTS OF DARKNESS are found within SHADOW CACHES, purchased from the Shadowy Market in the SHADOW TOWER.

items.name: Shadowy Schematic
items.description: This shade-touched parchment looks like a fragment of an engineering diagram.\n\nAcquired during the Portal to Darkness event, this item may fade back into the shadows over time.

items.name: Subzero Snowflake
items.description: Used to craft Snowfest mounts and Enchanted Snowballs. Will definitely melt sometime after Snowfest.

items.name: Phoenix Mote
items.description: Fractured essence of a Phoenix that can be used to craft a Phoenix Soul. Found rarely in the Sundered Uplands from bosses, invaders and dungeons.
items.guide: PHOENIX MOTES can be found rarely from the SUNDERED UPLANDS biome.

items.name: Phoenix Soul
items.description:
Captured soul of a Phoenix that can be used to gain the power of the sun. Used to craft the Solarion Class. 

Crafted at the Sundered Uplands bench.

items.name: Sun Beam Container
items.description:
A container that is said to be able to hold the power of the sun. Used to craft the Solarion Class. 

Crafted at the Sundered Uplands bench.

items.name: Sparkzite
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nSparks sometimes fly from this ore that grows deep in Tiers 3-5 of Sunken Sunvault.

items.name: Spring Bloom
items.description: Crafting Material.\n\nHarvested from Spring Bloom Seeds which can be crafted at the Gardening Bench.

items.name: Shaper's Star
items.description:
Locked away, this star grants true power to the Trovian who attains it. Use to forge Stellar equipment.

Obtained by using a Shaper's Star Key on chests in the Shores of the Everdark. Shaper's Star Keys can be crafted at the Shadowy Market.

items.name: Sun Sap
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nLiquid extracted from flowering pods in Tiers 1-3 of Sunken Sunvault.

items.name: Crystallized Sun Spark
items.description: Solar radiance shines curiously from inside this intricately mounted crystal. This event currency will disappear sometime after the event.

items.name: Carpet Talisman
items.description: Found very rarely in The Understacks in Delves of Depth 120 and deeper.

items.name: Meownt Talisman
items.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a meownt mount.\n\nFound very rarely in Moonless Dark (10) and lower adventure worlds.

items.name: Centaur Talisman
items.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a centaur mount.\n\nFound very rarely in Uber Twilight (12) and higher adventure worlds.

items.name: Corgi Talisman
items.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a corgi mount.\n\nFound very rarely in Moonless Dark (10) and lower adventure worlds.
items.guide: Found rarely in Moonless Dark (10) and lower Adventure Worlds.

items.name: Griffon Talisman
items.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a griffon mount.\n\nFound very rarely in Cursed Skylands worlds.

items.name: Llama Talisman
items.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a llama mount.\n\nFound very rarely in all adventure worlds.

items.name: Panda Talisman
items.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a panda mount.\n\nFound very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

items.name: Rat Talisman
items.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a rat mount.\n\nFound very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

items.name: Shmeep Talisman
items.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a shmeep mount.\n\nFound very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

items.name: Tentacle of Q'bthulhu
items.description: Forging Material.\n\nFound by defeating invaders and by Loot Collecting rare equipment.

items.name: Tentacle Slice
items.description: A clean-cut slice of slimy, shuddering shadow. Will rot after a while.

items.name: Titan Soul
items.description: Rare Crafting Material.\n\nObtained from the first six Shadowy Soul Vaults opened in Delves each week.

items.name: Diluted Draconic Essence
items.description: Used to craft Seasonal Draconic Essence from the DRAGON CRUCIBLE.\n\nObtained by LOOT COLLECTING Seasonal Draconic Essences, or purchased using DRAGON COINS from the DRACONIC BROWSER.

items.name: Burnt Draconic Essence
items.description:
Used to acquire TEMPORARY, Seasonal Draconic titles from the DRAGON CRUCIBLE.

Access the TITLE SELECTOR from the CHARACTER SHEET [HK:CharacterSheet]

Obtained uncommonly from Greater Dragon Caches.

items.name: Germinating Draconic Essence
items.description:
Used to acquire TEMPORARY, Seasonal Draconic titles from the DRAGON CRUCIBLE.

Access the TITLE SELECTOR from the CHARACTER SHEET [HK:CharacterSheet]

Obtained uncommonly from Greater Dragon Caches.

items.name: Scorching Draconic Essence
items.description:
Used to acquire TEMPORARY, Seasonal Draconic titles from the DRAGON CRUCIBLE.

Access the TITLE SELECTOR from the CHARACTER SHEET [HK:CharacterSheet]

Obtained uncommonly from Greater Dragon Caches.

items.name: Glacial Draconic Essence
items.description:
Used to acquire TEMPORARY, Seasonal Draconic titles from the DRAGON CRUCIBLE.

Access the TITLE SELECTOR from the CHARACTER SHEET [HK:CharacterSheet]

Obtained uncommonly from Greater Dragon Caches.

items.name: Title Authorization Form
items.description: Each one signed ahead-of-time by a single Trovian officiant! Some are famous!

items.name: Official Trovian Document Stamper
items.description:
Used to officially notarize important Trovian documents for official Trovian officials!

A micro-laboratory embedded in the handle can turn almost ANYTHING into ink suitable for Title signing!

NOTE!: The Official Trovian Document Stamper automatically returns to inventory after crafting titles. One is all you need!

items.name: Tradable Twinkling Tome
items.description: Forging Material. Loot Collect to transform into a Twinkling Tome, which is used to reduce the level requirement of equipment at the Enchanted Forge.

items.name: Twinkling Tome
items.description: Forging Material. Used to reduce the level requirement of equipment at the Enchanted Forge.\n\nCan be purchased in the Trove Store.

items.name: Turtle Shell
items.description:
Crafting Material.

Obtained by Loot Collecting Turtles caught with the Turtle Trawler.

items.name: Twilight Tress
items.description: A thick vine, wrapped around itself, almost like a dark braid of hair.

items.name: Veridium
items.description: Crafting Material. A crystalline green and blue ore that hardens reality against extra-dimensional invasions.\n\nThis ore is found commonly on the Geode Topside.

items.name: Wallflowers
items.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material.\n\nShy climbing plants that grow throughout Tiers 4-5 of the Geode caves.

items.name: Glim
items.description: Trading Material. Exchange for items from the pirates of Treasure Isles.\n\nObtained by Loot Collecting fish and breaking plants in the world.

items.name: Water Drop
items.description: A drop of crystalline water. Used to craft seeds.

items.name: Adventurine
items.description: Earned by completing daily Adventures, this valuable gemstone can be exchanged in Clubs and in the Hub for unusual and exotic goods.

items.name: Fool's Gold
items.description:
'Looks valuable at first glance, but it''s just a pretty rock.

Can be used to craft a recipe at the Radiant Dayspring during April Fool''s Day.

items.name: Elysian Emblem
items.description: Crafted on behalf of Trovians by Tauri. Demonstrates dedication to the Knights of Elysia.

items.name: Elysian Emblem
items.description: Crafted on behalf of Trovians by Tauri. Demonstrates dedication to the Knights of Elysia.

items.name: Clubit
items.description: Currency earned from participating in club activities. Can be exchanged for a variety of useful items.

items.name: Bomber Royale Coin: Season One
items.description: Originally obtained by successfully ranking in games of Bomber Royale Season One.\n\nCan also be purchased using Bomber Royale Coin: Season Two coins.

items.name: Bomber Royale Coin: Season Two
items.description: Obtained by successfully ranking in games of Bomber Royale Season Two.

items.name: Bomber Royale Coin: Blast Coin
items.description: Obtained from the "Bomb-nanza Balance Sheet: Blast Coins" Tome
items.guide:
BLAST COINS are given out by the BOMBER ROYALE Player-versus-Player system [HK:BomberRoyale]!

Scaredy cats can obtain these coins using the Bomb-nanza Balance Sheet: Blast Coins TOME, found on the BATTLE BENCH.

items.name: Burnt Battle Coin
items.description: Obtained by trading Season 1, Season 2, Blast Coins, or Battle Coins at the Bomber Bench or by tomes. Used to craft past season's rewards
items.guide:
Obtained by converting Blast Coins at the BATTLE BENCH.

Scaredy cats can obtain these coins using the Bomb-nanza Balance Sheet: Burnt Coins TOME, found on the BATTLE BENCH.

items.name: Diary Page 1/8
items.description: Day 3\n\nI'm still stomping mad at the changes.  Well I sure showed them.  I voted with my feet.  Now it's just this cheap diary and me down here in these server tunnels.

items.name: Diary Page 2/8
items.description:
Day 22

I'm so hungry.  My fishing rod does not work in this plasma.  I can see fish in there, but they don't react to my fishing rod at all.  And I think… I think I saw Avarem in the plasma.  What does that even mean?

I'm still hopping mad, at the changes as well as the glue in this defective diary.  I will keep trying to plasma fish.

items.name: Diary Page 3/8
items.description:
Day 47

Huge breakthrough yesterday!  I was trying to plasma fish yet again, when I got so angry.  I rage-ran into a wall and spilled everything I was carrying.  Somehow the Robotic Salvage mixed with Sticky Ichor and Builder knows what else, and it coated my fishing rod.

When I calmed down I did not know where I'd run to, but found my way back to… a fishing rod that works in plasma!

items.name: Diary Page 4/8
items.description:
Day 78

What the… several pages are missing from the diary!  It's the lousy glue.  I'm so steamed up I might just rage this diary straight into the forge!  Well, I think I have confirmed my suspicion.  Avarem IS a plasma fish operating the controls of a sophisticated Trovian-suit.

What other reason could there be for keeping the delicious secret of plasma fish from us for so long?

items.name: Diary Page 5/8
items.description:
Day 96

I was relaxing after a delicious meal of Carmintine Crab last night, when a real surprise happened.

I heard noises down the server racks!  These things power all the computations in Neon City, so the fans blow pretty loud and it's easy for someone to sneak up.  There has been no one down here with me for months now.

The newcomer appears to be a pirate parrot.  He seems pretty angry.  But not just tempermental… that's fine of course… but somehow… evil.  I will spy on him and not reveal myself.

items.name: Diary Page 6/8
items.description:
Day 127

The parrot is none other than the Dread Saltwater Sam!  I heard about him… he was everywhere at once with his swashbucklers.  Has he quit the world as well? I thought he settled down in the Hub to run a small business.  He's working on some sort of fool technology to clone himself.  Good luck with that.  If THAT exploit succeeds I will quit for sure. 

He is hungry.  Should I teach him how to plasma fish?  If I do, then a clone army might actually catch Avarem.  Then I could get answers to why things up there changed. 

Hmm.  Maybe I should.

items.name: Diary Page 7/8
items.description:
Day 235

I'm so generous.   I gently loot collected my lone plasma fishing rod into two pieces and hid half in the Dread Saltwater Sam's camp.  OK, it was actually a fit of rage and I smashed the thing in half, but it turned out pretty well, considering. 

He still does not know that I am here.  But I know about him.  And I think his clone army scheme is going to work.  With any luck, they will be able to clone the half-rod and feed themselves, growing a strong army that will take over the world! I mean, it can't get more ruined than it already is.

items.name: Diary Page 8/8
items.description:
Day 864

This is an outrage! 

The clone army, bellies full with MY plasma fish, are now marching up to… to… I can't believe it.  I overheard that they were going to… and this is exactly what I heard…' Make over the Fae for Rest'.  A makeover?  Instead of a world takeover?  I'm so angry right now.  Why do the Fae need a rest so badly anyways?  They should be outraged like me, not resting! 

That's it.  I am so finished with this place.  And this diary continues to lose pages – what's the point?  No one will ever read this anyways.  I'm finished!  And I'm taking my plasma fishing secrets with me! 

-Kevin.

items.name: The Hatastic Hat
items.description:
The Hatastic Hat. A pain-and-a-half to craft.
Stubborn, specific, with thinking monolithic.

Not deigning to be made, you just may hear it say,
"No, my crafter. Not here, at least not on this day."

Days of waiting, 'til it finally acceded,
"I have arrived, you're welcome," it spoke, conceited.

The Highlanders they clapped, the hat arrived at last,
On this their day of Sun, and in their grasslands, vast.

- Q.M.
